HArithmeticTrace.both_tests_PA_originalHaar_orbital_trace_of_AP.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [LocallyCompactSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)] [SecondCountableTopology (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)] [BorelSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) [addHaar.IsAddHaarMeasure] [addHaar.Regular]
  [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) [mu.IsHaarMeasure] (lambda : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K))
  [lambda.IsHaarMeasure] (a l r s : ℝ) (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (hh : Continuous phi) (hc : HasCompactSupport phi) (q : Fin 2) (u v : ℕ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu))
  (hcost : Summable fun i => ‖u i‖ * ‖v i‖)
  (hAP :
    ∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      HasSum (fun i => ⟪u i, F⟫_ℂ • v i)
        (((PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯).comp
            (JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s)ᗮ.starProjection)
          F)) :
  have ht := ⋯;
  have A := PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
  let W := JThetaAttachment.fullThetaClosure K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s;
  have P := Wᗮ.starProjection;
  have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
  have k := DNuclearKernel.kernel mu b u fun i => P (v i);
  have c := (NArithmeticUnfolding.quotientMeasure K lambda).haarScalarFactor mu;
  have orbit := fun j x =>
    ↑(∑' (t : Kˣ),
          NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * x) *
            NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K
              ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) t * ((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) j⁻¹ * x))) *
      k ↑((MasulloGRH.principalIdele K) j⁻¹ * x) ↑x;
  (∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
      (∀ᵐ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K) ∂mu, Integrable (fun y => k x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y))) mu) ∧
        ↑↑((P.comp A) F) =ᶠ[ae mu] fun x =>
          ↑(b x) * ∫ (y : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), k x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂mu) ∧
    Integrable (fun x => k x x) mu ∧
      ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), k x x ∂mu = Masullo.TraceClass.trace (P.comp A) ∧
        0 < c ∧
          Integrable (fun x => ↑(NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K x) * ∑' (j : Kˣ), orbit j x) lambda ∧
            Integrable (fun x => NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K x * ∑' (j : Kˣ), ‖orbit j x‖) lambda ∧
              ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeles K),
                  ↑(NDivisorialShells.arithmeticIndentation K x) * ∑' (j : Kˣ), orbit j x ∂lambda =
                ↑↑c * Masullo.TraceClass.trace (P.comp A)
